name: Michigan
sources: 2026 rate 4.25%: Michigan Treasury, 'State individual income tax rate for 2026 tax year determined', April 15, 2026 (michigan.gov/treasury/news/2026/04/15/state-individual-income-tax-rate-for-2026-tax-year-determined)

2026 personal exemption $5,900 (per filer and per dependent): Michigan Treasury, withholding 'Calendar Year Tax Information' (michigan.gov/taxes/business-taxes/withholding/calendar-year-tax-information)

Starts from federal AGI; no standard or itemized deduction; 2025 exemption $5,800: Michigan Treasury, 'Tax Year 2025 Information' (michigan.gov/taxes/iit/tax-guidance/tax-year-info/tax-year-2025-guidance)
provisional: 2026 personal exemption ($5,900) is from Treasury's 2026 withholding information; the 2026 MI-1040 instructions are not yet published
notes: City income taxes (levied by some cities, including Detroit and Grand Rapids) are not included.
Senior deductions (the retirement subtraction, or $20,000/$40,000 for those 67 and older) and the refundable homestead property tax credit are not included.
